parsed.notes:
The candidate requirements are under “Du”; “idealerweise” makes the affected bullets optional. “vorzugsweise” makes GCP optional specifically, not AWS or Azure.
AWS, Azure and GCP are interpreted as alternative examples for the Public Cloud experience ask; the broad cloud criterion is outside that group.
Version-control experience and GitHub collapse into the taxonomy's git criterion. GitLab and Bitbucket have no fitting entries; GitLab alone does not establish GitLab CI experience.
Technologies named only in responsibilities are excluded; the responsibilities' technology list is not treated as a dedicated tech-stack section.
Agile methods are an unmapped technical practice. Industry regulations and insurance/finance compliance knowledge are excluded as domain knowledge; cloud certifications are credentials rather than additional skills.
Seniority follows the explicit first-experience wording; “erfahrene” and “einschlägige Erfahrung” do not independently establish a higher level.
